briefdescription.para: Test MFA enrollment generation.
Test provisioning URI generation.
Test TOTP validation with current code.
Test TOTP validation with wrong code.
Test TOTP validation with wrong length.
Test TOTP validation with time window.
Test TOTP validation outside time window.
Test recovery code validation.
Test recovery code validation with invalid code.
Test recovery codes generation.
Test enrollment JSON serialization.
Test TOTP with 8-digit codes.
Test TOTP consistency - same secret and time should produce same code.
Test TOTP changes over time.
Test multiple users have different secrets.
Test that time_window > 2 throws std::invalid_argument.
Test that time_window == 2 is accepted (boundary value).
Test that drift metrics are recorded when TOTP validates at offset != 0.
Test that drift metrics are NOT recorded when TOTP validates at offset 0.
Verify that recovery-code validation latency does not vary by more than 100 µs based on the match position within a 10-code list.

detaileddescription.para: This test measures wall-clock timing and is therefore sensitive to CPU frequency scaling, scheduler jitter, sanitizer overhead, and CI load. It is opt-in: set the environment variable THEMIS_RUN_PERF_TESTS=1 to enable it. In production builds on dedicated hardware the implementation targets < 100 ns variance; the 100 µs gate here accommodates sanitizer and CI overhead while still detecting gross regressions.
The implementation always iterates all codes (constant-time linear scan), so the median latency for matching code[0] vs code[9] must be within the CI tolerance.
